subject: POC trial planning - RACI and success criteria (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: POC trial planning - RACI and success criteria (next steps)

Hi Emily / Raj

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the POC/trial: 

Recap (short):
- Goal: validate LLM-based clinical note summarization workflow for ambulatory clinics (throughput target: 10k notes/day; avg response latency <1s/token for interactive review).
- Key success criteria discussed: precision/completeness thresholds, latency targets, and integration points with their EHR export.

Proposed Success Criteria (please confirm or edit):
1) Accuracy: F1 >= 0.85 vs. your clinician-labeled sample set of 200 notes.
2) Latency: 95th percentile token latency <= 1.2s on dedicated instance profile (we can adjust once we see real load).
3) Cost envelope: projected inference cost <= $0.08 per note for baseline config.
4) Stability: no more than 1% error rate over a 72-hour continuous run.

POC evaluation plan / timeline (proposal):
- Week 1: Data sync + infra setup (network allowlist, sample export)
- Week 2: Baseline config run on 2000 notes, accuracy tuning
- Week 3: Scale run to 10k notes/day equivalent; measure latency/cost
- Week 4: Finalize report and go/no-go decision

Ownership / RACI (what we need from you):
- Infra (network, firewall, VPC peering): Acme infra owner (please nominate)
- App integration (ingest/export + mapping): Acme app owner (please nominate)
- Security / compliance sign-off (data handling, retention): Acme security/compliance lead
- Procurement / contracting: Acme procurement contact (for SOW / PO)

Attached: POC-success-criteria.docx, Network-reqs.xlsx (initial checklist).

Ask: Can you confirm the named owners for infra, app, security, and procurement by EOD Wednesday? Also confirm the week-of-3/22 as the start date for Week 1. If that works, I will circulate a formal RACI and calendar invites.

Thanks  happy to sync live if you prefer.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
